description: Search Facebook events by topic and city — local startDate/timezone, venue. 2 credits. Costs 2 credits. Empty results and failures are never charged. Pass cache=true for a free 24h cache hit (default always fresh).

cache.description: Set true to serve from the 24h response cache (0 credits on hit). Default false — always fetch fresh. Envelope includes cached + cachedAt on hits.

from.description: Inclusive local start date filter YYYY-MM-DD. Use for upcoming-only windows — Facebook/SERP may return past events.

limit.description: Max items to return (default 20, max 200). Flat 2 credits per call. Response `source` is native or extended (fetch path — not a price change).

location.description: City/place geo filter (e.g. London). Matches timezone, location.city, or coords near the city — not a title substring.

q.description: Topic keyword, e.g. 'comedy'. Pair with location for city-scoped results.

to.description: Inclusive local start date filter YYYY-MM-DD.

upcoming.description: When true and from is omitted, sets from to today's UTC date so past events are dropped.

name: facebook_event_search
title: Facebook Event Search
